_source: Verified against the official topview-ai-mcp npm package (publisher
topview-xuejia@tabcut.com), which ships Topview's own API client:
'Topview-Uid: <uid>', every response wrapped as {code, message, result}
where code '200' means success, and task queries polled with ?taskId=.
Superscale has no REST API at all - api.superscale.ai does not resolve and
its docs publish no key, bearer or base url. It ships an MCP server instead
(https://mcp.superscale.ai/mcp, OAuth, Pro plan and up), so it is connected
with scripts/setup-superscale-mcp.sh rather than called from here.
